verdict.rationale: v0 itself is marketed and documented as a built-in AI agent that plans tasks, generates code, diagnoses/fixes build failures, and connects to databases as it builds, matching the 'delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant' story directly. This is corroborated by first-party docs (agent framing, auto-fix, task planning) and community hands-on reports of successfully delegating full app-building tasks to v0. Missing for 10: independent benchmarking of task delegation reliability/scope beyond anecdotal reports, and clearer documentation of limits on autonomous multi-step task execution.
